missing: Whether each dock ships with a charger and what wattage actually reaches the Deck while gaming on a 4K TV, plus the fact the Deck itself caps at 4K60 so HDMI 2.1 docks buy nothing — only LevelRig touches charger-in-box, nobody measures delivered charging.
why: Two major reviewers that test hardware, GamesRadar and PCGamesN, both answer this exact question with tested picks that call out 4K output and 100W power delivery, and Pocket Tactics adds a third branded guide. Three niche sites (LevelRig, Manbolo, Soldermag) also answer it with specs and prices. A new Dealectric page would be fighting established tested guides, not filling a gap.
